title: Uruguayan Broccoli Gratin
description: A twist on the classic gratin, this dish combines the rich flavors of Uruguay with the earthy goodness of broccoli.
instructions: 2. Rinse the broccoli and cut it into florets.
3. In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
4. Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
5. Add the broccoli to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
6. In a separate bowl, mix the gratin and a pinch of salt and pepper.
7. Transfer the broccoli to a baking dish and top with the gratin mixture.
8. Bake for 15-20 minutes, until the top is golden brown and the gratin is bubbly.
9. Serve hot, garnished with additional gratin if desired.
